title: Overhang Electrical Outlet Installation
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE.AIR FORCE SPECIAL OPERATIONS COMMAND.FA4417 1 SOCONS
detail_text: This is a Sources Sought notice; there is no solicitation available at this time. Requests for solicitation will receive no response. This Sources Sought notice is published for market research purposes only. This market survey is conducted to identify potential sources capable of meeting the requirement. The objective of this project is to upgrade an external 30A plug to a 100A plug. This includes running a conduit and the appropriate running from the breaker box of the buildings interior to the exterior location. The 100-amp receptacle is needed to support mission essential equipment that require more than 30-amps of power prior to mission-start, during checks and system runs. Using a higher power receptacle allows the systems to be powered safely and efficiently without overloading existing outlets. The upgrade reduces time related to set-up, assists in the support of mission equipment, and enables the facility to meet mission demand. All prospective contractors must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) database to be awarded a Department of Defense contract. This acquisition will be set-aside strictly for small business concerns. Contractors responding to this notice shall confirm that they are a small business and identify their participation in any small business socioeconomic contracting program(s). The results from market research may determine the potential for a particular socioeconomic set-aside.Please review the document attached.
